description: Line drawing on spiral-bound sketchbook paper showing tall trees with thin, bare branches. The central tree is the most detailed, with vertical trunk lines and horizontal branches extending outward. Surrounding trees are lightly sketched with minimal detail. The background is blank, emphasizing the fine lines of the drawing.
title: Untitled (Tree)
